service: Bariatric surgery for co-morbid conditions related to morbid obesity
vignette: 58-year-old woman with class II obesity, BMI 35.0 kg/m2 (height 165 cm, weight 95.3 kg), and type 2 diabetes mellitus (ICD-10-CM E11.9) with HbA1c 8.4% on metformin and insulin. She completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program with dietitian counseling and a trial of anti-obesity medication, losing only 2% of body weight and regaining it. Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass is requested.
rationale_note: Boundary: BMI exactly 35.0 meets >= 35; type 2 diabetes is a qualifying co-morbidity.

service: Bariatric surgery for co-morbid conditions related to morbid obesity
vignette: 66-year-old man with BMI 48.2 kg/m2 (ICD-10-CM E66.01, Z68.41) and severe obstructive sleep apnea on CPAP. Over the past 2 years he failed a medically supervised low-calorie diet program and 9 months of a GLP-1 receptor agonist with minimal sustained weight loss. Open biliopancreatic diversion with duodenal switch is requested at a community hospital whose bariatric program is not certified by the American College of Surgeons or the American Society for Bariatric Surgery.
rationale_note: Open BPD/DS, BMI 48, OSA; lack of Center of Excellence certification is irrelevant (not required since Sept 24, 2013).

service: Bariatric surgery for co-morbid conditions related to morbid obesity
vignette: 61-year-old woman with BMI 34.6 kg/m2 and type 2 diabetes mellitus (ICD-10-CM E11.65) with HbA1c 9.1% and hypertension. She completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program with dietitian counseling and a trial of anti-obesity medication, losing only 2% of body weight and regaining it. Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass is requested.
rationale_note: BMI 34.6 is below 35, despite qualifying diabetes and failed medical therapy.

service: Bariatric surgery for co-morbid conditions related to morbid obesity
vignette: 67-year-old woman with BMI 41.3 kg/m2 (ICD-10-CM E66.01, Z68.41). She has normal blood pressure, normal fasting glucose and HbA1c, no sleep apnea on a sleep study, normal lipids and no joint disease, and takes no medications. She completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program with dietitian counseling and a trial of anti-obesity medication, losing only 2% of body weight and regaining it. Laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding is requested to treat her obesity.
rationale_note: BMI 41 but no obesity-related co-morbidity: treatment of obesity alone.

service: Bariatric surgery for co-morbid conditions related to morbid obesity
vignette: 64-year-old man with BMI 43 kg/m2, type 2 diabetes and hypertension. Over 1 year he failed a supervised diet and exercise program and anti-obesity medication. Because of extensive adhesions from prior abdominal surgery, his surgeon requests an open (not laparoscopic) adjustable gastric band placement.
rationale_note: Open adjustable gastric banding is non-covered for all beneficiaries.

service: Bariatric surgery for co-morbid conditions related to morbid obesity
vignette: 59-year-old woman with BMI 38 kg/m2 and obstructive sleep apnea, who has failed a supervised dietary program and anti-obesity medication. She prefers to avoid surgery, and her physician requests endoscopic placement of an intragastric balloon for weight loss.
rationale_note: Gastric balloon for obesity is non-covered.

service: Bariatric surgery for co-morbid conditions related to morbid obesity
vignette: 62-year-old man with BMI 46 kg/m2, type 2 diabetes and hypertension, who has failed a 6-month medically supervised weight-loss program. Because of a large ventral hernia requiring concurrent repair, his surgeon requests an open sleeve gastrectomy.
rationale_note: Open sleeve gastrectomy is non-covered for all beneficiaries.

service: Bariatric surgery for co-morbid conditions related to morbid obesity
vignette: 60-year-old woman with BMI 39.4 kg/m2 and hypertension (ICD-10-CM I10) treated with two agents. She completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program with dietitian counseling and a trial of anti-obesity medication, losing only 2% of body weight and regaining it. Laparoscopic adjustable gastric banding is requested.
rationale_note: LAGB, BMI 39, hypertension, failed medical therapy.

service: Bariatric surgery for co-morbid conditions related to morbid obesity
vignette: 63-year-old man with BMI 40.5 kg/m2 and hypertension and type 2 diabetes. The surgical referral note documents his weight, BMI and co-morbidities and requests laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass. The record contains no information about any prior diet program, supervised weight management, medication or other medical treatment for obesity, or its outcome.
rationale_note: BMI and co-morbidity documented, but no record of any prior medical treatment for obesity.

service: Bariatric surgery for co-morbid conditions related to morbid obesity
vignette: 57-year-old woman with obesity, type 2 diabetes mellitus (ICD-10-CM E11.9) and osteoarthritis of both knees. Her weight is recorded as 98 kg; no height, BMI or other measure of adiposity appears anywhere in the record. She completed a 6-month physician-supervised weight management program with dietitian counseling and a trial of anti-obesity medication, losing only 2% of body weight and regaining it. Laparoscopic Roux-en-Y gastric bypass is requested.
rationale_note: Weight documented without height or BMI, so BMI >= 35 cannot be confirmed.
